children: The CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) may fall to $13.14-1/2 per bushel, a channel technique and projection analysis suggest.
The market has fallen below a rising channel, after completing a five-wave cycle. A duplicated channel suggests a target of $13.14-1/2, the 50% projection level of the cycle from $13.
A break above $13.22-1/2 may lead to a moderate gain into the $13.25 to $13.26-1/2 range.
